fulfillments.description: This is an aggregate used to display a personalized text message in the banner. Map the string name of the chosen holiday destination here. fulfillments.description: This is an aggregate used to display a personalized text message in the banner. Map the last viewed url here. It is also possible to create an url based on the information tracked in your events. To do so, create the url directly in the banner ("Url parameter"). If you wish to change the content of the banner, feel free to map other information from the latest research conducted on the website.
